dissent: The uncharged case-level replay may be explicitly sanctioned by the obligated interface the docstring cites (proposal:10-12); that interface text is not in the packet, so it is recorded as a reservation, not a defect.
The per-field proof checks (proposal:166-177) are redundant given the exact audit_case re-audit already recomputes identity_proof via identity_audit.check typed equality; redundancy is harmless.
findings: F1 (soundness): embedded profile is never bound to the frozen domain. proposal:111 takes profile=case['source']['profile']; fixed-prefix-suffix (117-119), validate_inventory (123) and audit_case (141) are all evaluated against that embedded profile. Unlike boundary.py::explore (profile=c.domain({'domain':DOMAIN})) and validate_frozen's profile_sha256 binding, nothing requires the real scale-eight-action-race profile (s_domain.py PROFILES). Counterexample fixture: a self-consistent case under a fabricated 34-action profile sharing the eight core literals at positions 11..18 but different prefix/suffix literals or weakened requires; every check including re-audit passes though it is not a boundary-01 artifact. Minimal correction: d.require(d.exact(profile, c.domain({'domain':'scale-eight-action-race'}))) or a pinned digest; also enforce zfill(6) index format (proposal:106 accepts any isdigit).

F2 (control vacuity): 'wrong-global-index' (b_index, proposal:213-215) copies cases[1]'s index. boundary.py::explore orders flat as (sel,unit) pairs, so the natural fixture has cases[0]/cases[1] sharing the global index across units; rename then reproduces the identical name, the mutant is byte-identical and reports 'undetected:supported'. Fixture shape: cases=[boundary-01/<k>/event/1, boundary-01/<k>/utf8-byte/1]. Same adjacency makes b_stale (220-224) collapse into duplicate-certificate detection. Minimal correction: pick first cases[j] with index != cases[0]'s index, or synthesize (rank+1)%40320 zfill(6).

F3 (unfireable checks): 'deterministic-gzip' (proposal:126) compares _raw(case) to recomputed _raw(case), a pure function, so it cannot fail and never compares against supplied stored bytes/hash; 'stale-artifact-reuse' (130-133) keys on raw which embeds case['case'], and duplicate names are already rejected (129), so identical raw under a different name is unreachable — b_stale is actually caught by 'global-index'. Minimal correction: compare raw to a supplied artifact_sha256; drop or re-key the reuse check on a name-excluded canonicalization.

F4 (coverage gap + reservation): wave04 review-defects boundary list expects wrong-ordinal/filename, altered whole-inventory hash, changed non-witness summary/census/observation, false visit count, changed actual Q generation, journal-only disagreement, dropped refusal and staged-identity-as-authority; run_controls exercises only 11 mutations and omits all of these (audit_case re-audit would likely catch several, but discrimination is undemonstrated). Reservation: the dominant per-repeat cost (audit_case = two restores + 34-row recomputation, ~12 invocations across baseline+attempts) is uncharged; only the 35 per-prefix takes are charged — consistent with the docstring's claimed obligated interface but unverifiable from the packet.
limitations: s_audit/a_audit sources are absent; 'initial-state-unit' (proposal:134-136) assumes sc/audit initialization is non-mutating — if it mutates stored initials, legitimate certificates yield false counterexamples.
